• Llamada conectando

5G

9:16

"Create a realistic iPhone FaceTime interface in 9:16.
The incoming caller is named [CALLER NAME].
Create the following images separately, not as a collage:
Incoming FaceTime call screen showing [CALLER NAME].
The same interface with the answer slider moved completely to the right.
The connecting state immediately after answering.

The beginning of the FaceTime conversation.

Keep the interface perfectly consistent between every image.

Status bar:
Time: [TIME]
Battery: [BATTERY %]
Network: [NETWORK]
Signal: [NUMBER OF BARS]
Location icon: [ON/OFF]

Use a realistic modern iPhone interface, black background and authentic iOS proportions.

Aspect ratio: 9:16."

Llamante: Maddie

[Hilo 2] 2/4

Una vez que la UI estuvo lista, creé a los personajes.

Maddie se generó por separado para poder usarla como referencia de personaje consistente durante todo el video.

Ashley ya estaba generada dentro de mi interfaz de FaceTime, así que realmente no necesitaba crear otra referencia para ella.

Pero si el personaje generado dentro de tu UI no se ve como quieres, simplemente puedes crear otro personaje por separado y reemplazar a esa persona después.

"an front view of a slender, shadowy humanoid entity with a skeletal frame, set against a plain white studio background. the entire body is a uniform, matte black color with a rough, organic skin texture that emphasizes its ribs and muscular structure. its limbs are unnaturally long, with arms reaching down to its mid shins and hands with sharp, elongated fingers. the head is bald and devoid of any facial features, inclined slightly to the left"
